def parse_grid_rows(text, start, nrows, ncols):
    lines=text[start:].splitlines()
    rows=[]
    for line in lines:
        vals=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', line)]
        if len(vals)==ncols:
            rows.append(vals)
            if len(rows)==nrows: break
        elif rows:
            break
    if len(rows)!=nrows: raise ValueError((len(rows), nrows, ncols, lines[:3]))
    return rows
pairs=[]
for mi in range(1,5):
    t=msgs[mi]
    hi=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
    h,w=map(int,hi.groups())
    inp=parse_grid_rows(t,hi.end(),h,w)
    ho=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
    oh,ow=map(int,ho.groups())
    out=parse_grid_rows(t,ho.end(),oh,ow)
    pairs.append((inp,out))
print([(len(i),len(i[0]),len(o),len(o[0])) for i,o in pairs])

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The two equal-sized panels are separated by a uniform middle row or column.
    if w % 2 == 1 and all(row[w // 2] == grid[0][w // 2] for row in grid):
        k = w // 2
        left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        right = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
    elif h % 2 == 1 and all(value == grid[h // 2][0] for value in grid[h // 2]):
        k = h // 2
        left = grid[:k]
        right = grid[k + 1:]
    else:
        raise ValueError("expected a uniform middle separator")

    common = set(value for row in left for value in row) & set(value for row in right for value in row)
    if len(common) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected exactly one color shared by both panels")
    color = next(iter(common))

    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
         for c in range(len(left[0]))]
        for r in range(len(left))
    ]
'''
